description: Let \((A_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}\) be sets with specified injections \(e_n:A_n\to\mathbb N\). For \(x\in\bigcup_n A_n\), let \(n(x)\) be the least index with \(x\in A_{n(x)}\). The map \(x\mapsto(n(x),e_{n(x)}(x))\) is injective.
signature:
